keyset_id_finding.summary: CDK 0.18's V4 token serialization writes the token-level keyset id as the 8-byte prefix of the canonical id (01e73e75a0809604), not the full 33 bytes.

evidence.target: CBOR decode of the committed fixture
evidence.observed: t[0].i = bytes 01e73e75a0809604 (8 bytes) while the mint's keyset id is 01e73e75...e6 (33 bytes)

keyset_id_finding.implications: Every V4 consumer must resolve the 8-byte prefix against the mint's keyset list before swapping — which is exactly the resolution behavior the backend exhibited on the v3 truncated-id fixture. The 'v2-short' truncation a test minter adopted (PRTA#247) is this native V4 spelling transplanted into V3. Minting NEW V3 tokens with truncated ids remains forbidden; RESOLVING a short id to the canonical keyset is required for V4.
